CustomField.description: Priority of the case as per ANZ process guidelines.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A ‘Customer experiencing Financial Hardship’ is when a customer wants to pay but can't. A ‘Customer experiencing Vulnerability’ is when, as a result of their personal circumstances or characteristics, the customer may be more likely than others to experience financial harm or detriment. For further information, search ‘Customer Vulnerability’ on Max.
